en.title: NOMA Everyday Essentials
en.summary: A demo journey showing how a design moves from a client request to a locked final output.
en.brief: Demo brief: define the request, the audience, the product context and the final delivery criteria.
en.problem: The visual challenge is to create a distinct system while keeping the communication clear and production-ready.
en.thinking: Research, hierarchy, typography, colour and practical production constraints are connected into one framework.
en.direction: A focused visual system with strong hierarchy, controlled typography and a repeatable graphic gesture.
en.solution: A modular design that can extend across variants, sizes and supporting communication.
en.production: The artwork is prepared around measurement, safe area, dieline and print constraints.
en.mockup: The final direction is presented in context so the client can judge scale, balance and shelf presence.
en.feedback: Demo feedback: replace this with the real client comments and change requests.
en.result: Demo final: replace this with the approved, delivered output.

bn.title: NOMA Everyday Essentials — ডেমো
bn.summary: একটি design journey-এর demo, যেখানে client request থেকে final locked output পর্যন্ত ধাপগুলো দেখা যায়।
bn.brief: Demo brief: client request, audience, product context এবং delivery criteria পরিষ্কার করা।
bn.problem: Distinct visual system তৈরি করতে হবে, আবার communication ও production-ready structure-ও ঠিক রাখতে হবে।
bn.thinking: Research, hierarchy, typography, colour ও production constraint-কে এক framework-এর মধ্যে আনা।
bn.direction: Strong hierarchy, controlled typography ও repeatable graphic gesture দিয়ে একটি focused visual system.
bn.solution: Variant, size ও supporting communication-এ scale করা যায় এমন modular design.
bn.production: Measurement, safe area, dieline ও print constraint মাথায় রেখে artwork প্রস্তুত করা।
bn.mockup: Context mockup-এর মাধ্যমে scale, balance ও shelf presence দেখানো।
bn.feedback: Demo feedback: এখানে real client feedback ও change request বসবে।
bn.result: Demo final: approved final output এখানে বসবে।

en.title: 01 / The Brief
en.description: The client request, product context and success criteria are captured before visual work begins.
en.description_bn: ক্লায়েন্টের চাহিদা, product context ও success criteria প্রথমে পরিষ্কার করা হয়।

en.title: 02 / The Framework
en.description: Measurements, dieline, line structure and production constraints become the working framework.
en.description_bn: Measurement, dieline, line structure ও production constraint দিয়ে কাজের framework তৈরি করা হয়।

en.title: 03 / The Design
en.description: Research turns into hierarchy, typography, colour and the first presentable visual direction.
en.description_bn: Research থেকে hierarchy, typography, colour ও প্রথম presentable visual direction তৈরি হয়।

en.title: 04 / The Feedback
en.description: Client review is recorded, changes are identified and the next round is defined.
en.description_bn: Client review, required changes ও next round পরিষ্কারভাবে নির্ধারণ করা হয়।

en.title: 05 / The Final
en.description: The design is locked, production files are delivered and the final output is presented.
en.description_bn: Design lock করে production file deliver করা হয় এবং final output দেখানো হয়।

en.brief: Demo brief: define the request, the audience, the product context and the final delivery criteria.
en.problem: The visual challenge is to create a distinct system while keeping the communication clear and production-ready.
en.thinking: Research, hierarchy, typography, colour and practical production constraints are connected into one framework.
en.direction: A focused visual system with strong hierarchy, controlled typography and a repeatable graphic gesture.
en.solution: A modular design that can extend across variants, sizes and supporting communication.
en.production: The artwork is prepared around measurement, safe area, dieline and print constraints.
en.mockup: The final direction is presented in context so the client can judge scale, balance and shelf presence.
en.feedback: Demo feedback: replace this with the real client comments and change requests.
en.result: Demo final: replace this with the approved, delivered output.

bn.title: FRESH Daily FMCG — ডেমো
bn.summary: একটি design journey-এর demo, যেখানে client request থেকে final locked output পর্যন্ত ধাপগুলো দেখা যায়।
bn.brief: Demo brief: client request, audience, product context এবং delivery criteria পরিষ্কার করা।
bn.problem: Distinct visual system তৈরি করতে হবে, আবার communication ও production-ready structure-ও ঠিক রাখতে হবে।
bn.thinking: Research, hierarchy, typography, colour ও production constraint-কে এক framework-এর মধ্যে আনা।
bn.direction: Strong hierarchy, controlled typography ও repeatable graphic gesture দিয়ে একটি focused visual system.
bn.solution: Variant, size ও supporting communication-এ scale করা যায় এমন modular design.
bn.production: Measurement, safe area, dieline ও print constraint মাথায় রেখে artwork প্রস্তুত করা।
bn.mockup: Context mockup-এর মাধ্যমে scale, balance ও shelf presence দেখানো।
bn.feedback: Demo feedback: এখানে real client feedback ও change request বসবে।
bn.result: Demo final: approved final output এখানে বসবে।

en.title: 01 / The Brief
en.description: The client request, product context and success criteria are captured before visual work begins.
en.description_bn: ক্লায়েন্টের চাহিদা, product context ও success criteria প্রথমে পরিষ্কার করা হয়।

en.title: 02 / The Framework
en.description: Measurements, dieline, line structure and production constraints become the working framework.
en.description_bn: Measurement, dieline, line structure ও production constraint দিয়ে কাজের framework তৈরি করা হয়।

en.title: 03 / The Design
en.description: Research turns into hierarchy, typography, colour and the first presentable visual direction.
en.description_bn: Research থেকে hierarchy, typography, colour ও প্রথম presentable visual direction তৈরি হয়।

en.title: 04 / The Feedback
en.description: Client review is recorded, changes are identified and the next round is defined.
en.description_bn: Client review, required changes ও next round পরিষ্কারভাবে নির্ধারণ করা হয়।

en.title: 05 / The Final
en.description: The design is locked, production files are delivered and the final output is presented.
en.description_bn: Design lock করে production file deliver করা হয় এবং final output দেখানো হয়।
